title: Where the Sky Forgets What It Was Asking

features.name: the anemometer that forgot direction
features.desc-on-touch: The wind-cup spinner turns in a direction that hasn't existed for three storm-seasons. The archive watches it, learning what confusion looks like when it moves.

features.name: barometric inversion pool
features.desc-on-touch: Where the pressure reading sinks below ground, light fills the hole instead. You can't read which way the weather is turning.

features.name: the questioning vapour
features.desc-on-touch: A cloud column that shifts between three shapes: a question mark, a pause, and a blank. The archive copies it, wondering if it means the same thing.

features.name: storm-radio on the silent band
features.desc-on-touch: The antenna broadcasts weather words but they leave the speaker backwards, unspoken, returning to the sky as questions nobody voiced.

features.name: sideways lightning that stopped
features.desc-on-touch: Current that moved horizontal across the darkening once, asking the air instead of striking it. Now it hangs, polite and doubting, not sure if it should move again.

inscription: the sky once knew what it was searching for; now it searches and forgets the wanting in the same breath
